# Statechart invocation examples

These are unmodified examples 13–17 from `torbjornlager/trinity-demonstrator`,
`examples/statecharts/`, revision `7ca1203829b84cbcb057607519edcc43e4953784`. They are vendored here so
the packaged runtime tests execute the published example programs without
requiring another checkout or a live public node.

The Worker regression scenarios assert child behaviour, final completion or
explicit halt, and resource cleanup. Refresh these fixtures when the examples
change; preserve their original source and teaching comments.
